product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI recruiting platform for recruiters and hiring teams that reviews and scores applicants’ resumes against job requirements and custom signals to surface qualified candidates faster.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is marketing/recruiting content and does not show at least two engineering or technical product-build posts.

public_docs.notes: The homepage exposes an FAQ but no public documentation site, help center, or developer portal in its navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No Speak_ careers page or job board with live roles was located.

model_provider.notes: Public materials say the product uses a mix of proprietary models and external/open-AI solutions, but do not identify a model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy explicitly discusses GDPR/UK GDPR compliance obligations; it does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest completed round shown is a May 2023 seed round, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No Speak_ careers page or job board with live roles was located.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest located launch-type announcements describe Speak v2.0/Auto Generated Signals in September 2024 and a new product in February 2024, both before the window beginning 2026-05-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small, fully readable team page lists the CEO, Head of Product, Head of Operations, and Community Manager, with no indication of a C-level or VP-level joiner in the window and no departure announcement.
